name: openemr
description: Owner-managed isolated OpenEMR instances with a private MariaDB database, local recovery points, and pinned upgrade path.

hostTools.name: docker
hostTools.reason: OpenEMR and MariaDB run in isolated owner-labeled containers.

hostTools.name: kopia
hostTools.reason: Optional encrypted filesystem backup for already verified OpenEMR recovery snapshots; DBM remains the preferred registered backup route.

instances.rationale: Per-instance MariaDB files, OpenEMR site files and generated state persist until that exact synthetic instance is removed.

snapshots.rationale: Quiesced local recovery points are retained until explicit owner removal and are registered as backup-manager filesystem targets.

secrets.rationale: OpenEMR credentials are private 0600 files outside backup targets. Kopia recovery passwords remain until the external repository is retired.

kopia.rationale: Private Kopia configs and caches remain after instance removal so an encrypted external repository can still be connected and restored.

linux.reason: This resource depends on the control-plane Docker lifecycle; no desktop bundle or installer is defined.
limitations: Synthetic isolated Linux host use only until desktop runtime ownership is designed and verified.
